messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: high error rate on /v1/infer (500s) — sev=2 — attempted PagerDuty paging but delivery failed :warning:
incident-bot: pagerduty delivery status: FAILED (403) — webhook signature mismatch — retrying 3 times
tyler (oncall): seeing this now, thanks. Did PD accept the webhook earlier today?
maria (sre): we rolled a small API gateway change 12m ago. I flagged the sig header rename in the change but thought PD webhook uses legacy header.
tyler (oncall): ok taking lead. Can someone confirm customer impact?
nina (support): support queue shows ~7 new realtime errors, 3 customers reported timeouts from embedded widgets. Not full outage but bad latency and errors.
joel (eng-runtime): putting runtime autoscaler healthy but errors are downstream. Logs show repeated 403 from pagerduty endpoint when our webhook attempts to trigger: ``POST https://events.pagerduty.com/v2/enqueue -> 403 {"error": "signature mismatch"}``
maria (sre): that explains it — PD rejects the webhook so oncall wasn't paged. We need to manually escalate while we fix
tyler (oncall): can someone call the oncall phone bridge manually? pagerbot didn't page. I don't see any rotations rung.
ops-bot: Suggested action: `call_manual` flow available in /tools/ops — use `ops call --number=+1-415-555-0123 --text="Pager outage: /v1/infer errors"`
joel (eng-runtime): running a manual PD incident create now (UI) and calling the oncall rotation list. Posting incident link: https://redwood.pagerduty.com/incidents/PDR123456
tyler (oncall): I'm on the bridge. joining.
maria (sre): quick mitigation: revert gateway header rename (deploy rollback in progress) — tagging @eng-runtime
joel (eng-runtime): rollback started. posting deploy id: deploy-2026-03-09-1432. Will watch.
maria (sre): while rollback happens, can someone manually send pages for SEV to our mobile phones? Use PD incident link and `Notify -> Escalate`.
ops-bot: Reminder: incident channel automation (auto-ack, runbooks) depends on PD webhooks. Until PD accepts webhooks, some automations will not run.
tyler (oncall): manually emailed the SRE rotation list and tweeted SMS to lead phones. Also posted a sticky message in #eng-oncall.
nina (support): updated affected customers: "We're aware of delivery errors for inference calls, engineering investigating. Temporary workaround: retry requests; small chance of 500/timeout."
joel (eng-runtime): rollback complete. gateway config back to `pd-signature: X-PD-Signature`. Retrying test webhook now.
joel (eng-runtime): running curl test:
```
curl -v -X POST https://events.pagerduty.com/v2/enqueue \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'X-PD-Signature: sha256=abc123' \
  -d '{"routing_key": "REDACTED", "payload": {"summary": "test", "source":"redwood"}}'
```
joel (eng-runtime): response 202 Accepted — webhook delivery OK. PD accepted the test event.
incident-bot: PagerDuty delivery status: SUCCESS (202) — webhooks now accepted.
tyler (oncall): are pages firing for the live incident now?
pagerbot: Incident PDR123456 -> notification sent to rotation `sre-oncall` at 1763256845
maria (sre): I see the rotation rung and Tyler acknowledged. Good.
nina (support): support reports customers seeing errors drop significantly. A few retries succeeded.
tyler (oncall): great. action items: 1) postmortem on webhook config change, 2) add automated smoke to detect PD webhook 5xx/4xx and fall back to SMS/manual escalation, 3) add monitoring alert that triggers Slack and email if PD paging fails X times, 4) update runbook with manual phone escalation steps.
joel (eng-runtime): filing PR to make gateway header migration opt-in and add a compatibility flag.
maria (sre): I'll open the incident ticket in our tracker (INC-2026-317) and add timeline.
tyler (oncall): closing loop: incident severity lowered to sev=3 (recovery in progress), pages restored. Will follow up with postmortem. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: Note: consider rotating PD signing key next maintenance window after PM approves change.
joel (eng-runtime): root cause summary: gateway config change renamed PD signature header -> caused PD to reject webhooks (403). Rollback restored header.
maria (sre): impact summary for postmortem: ~10 minutes of missed automated paging for SRE, ~15-20 customers saw transient 500s/timeouts, mitigation: rollback + manual paging.
tyler (oncall): thanks everyone. I'll draft a short incident blurb for #general and schedule a postmortem sync.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: PDR123456 status: acknowledged -> monitoring. Incident channel automation resumed.
joel (eng-runtime): follow-up tickets: GW-1253 (compat flag), GW-1254 (smoke test), RUN-842 (manual escalation doc).
maria (sre): assigning postmortem to Tyler and Joel.
tyler (oncall): assigning to myself and Joel. I'll ping for a 30m postmortem slot tomorrow."
